test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is Whorle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word 'whorle' is 'whorl'.
 
• The word '**whorl**'' means '**a pattern of spirals or concentric circles**.'
 
 
• Example: Shelley drew larger and larger dark whorls on her notepad.
 
 
 
• Hence 'whorle' is the incorrectly spelt word.
 
• Thus, option 1 is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's see meaning of other options-

 
 
• Winch- A hauling or lifting device consisting of a rope or chain winding round a horizontal rotating drum, turned typically by a crank or by motor.
 
• Weird- Suggesting something supernatural; unearthly.
 
• Wench- A girl or young woman.
